title: Sum the Itô energy over a time grid
source_anchor: Original Samplinglib supplement: Sum the Itô energy over a time grid. Exact assumptions and formula below.
target_statement: Take a scalar completed Itô integral of a progressive square-integrable integrand. The sum of its squared increments along a finite nondecreasing deterministic grid is integrable. Its expectation is the integrand's squared energy over the half-open span of the grid.
